note: Input bytes beginning with '<' and a non-alnum character after the prefix are routed into the script-tag parser when script tags are enabled.
The scanner advances through the input while tracking quoted regions, so the closing-tag search depends on the full attacker-controlled buffer.
The end-tag check reads one byte past the matched tag name; for a short malformed closing tag this can access beyond the provided buffer and trigger the reported heap-buffer-overflow read.
